title: UnitsTable
description: Shape of packages/spec/units.json, the single table of quantity kinds, allowed units and unit systems. A value in unit u converts to SI as value * factor + offset.

systems.description: Named unit systems, keyed by id. A system names one unit for every kind; it is the unit a quantity field offers first and the unit results are shown in. Values are still stored as typed.

defaultSystem.description: Id of the system a project uses until its owner chooses another.

si.description: The SI unit stored and solved in. It must appear in units with factor 1 and offset 0.

definition.description: Where the factor comes from, so a reviewer can check it.

name.description: Shown in the unit system choice.

units.description: Quantity kind to unit symbol. Every kind of the table must appear, with a unit listed under that kind.
